meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: They have to be washed carefully by hand.
Put the glasses carefully on the table.

examples.text: Ты что, Аркашка? Это же югославские вещи! Их аккуратно руками надо стирать.
examples.trans: Are you crazy, Arkashka? These are Yugoslavian things! They have to be washed carefully by hand.

meanings.note: moving or capable of moving at high speed

examples.trans: We need fast internet.

examples.text: Они сказали, что устанавливают быстрый интернет.
examples.trans: They said that they were installing fast internet.

examples.text: Большое спасибо за вашу быструю помощь!
examples.trans: Thank you very much for your quick help!
Who are your rivals?
Is this your programme?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
Everything's fine.
As you all know...
Share with everyone.
I have a question.
It's a very important matter.

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
There, look.
Here's my toy car.
All right, here you go. There, look.
I don't have time.
We're having a good time.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'егда').

examples.trans: She's always like that.
There's always a way out.
She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('stupid, silly, foolish').

examples.trans: Vanya, are you stupid?
That was a silly joke.

examples.text: Ваня, ты глупый? Зачем ты сейчас это при нём сказал?
examples.trans: Vanya, are you stupid? Why did you just say that in front of him?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cook; to prepare', paired with 'приготовить'.

examples.trans: I'm cooking lunch.
Mum cooks well.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: What are you doing?
I'm making dinner.
Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('wooden').

examples.trans: A wooden house.
They are setting our wooden walls on fire!

examples.text: Я уже приготовил специальный деревянный молоток.
examples.trans: I already prepared a special wooden mallet.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: I have to work.
Greed should be moderate.

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: But you've still got some.
But I know.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Thank you for your trust!
Thanks for the present.
What for?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'давать'). Used as an verbal verb meaning 'to ask, pose'.

examples.trans: To ask a question.

examples.text: Все ваши вопросы задавайте в мэрию!
examples.trans: Address all your questions to the mayor's office!

examples.text: Не задавай глупых вопросов, работай быстрее!
examples.trans: Do not ask stupid questions, work faster!

examples.text: Я делаю всё точно по вашему заказу.
examples.trans: I do everything exactly according to your order.
In the kitchen they are preparing this order.
The waiter took the order.
I'm here.
We live here.
But we're in business here.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
Dad and Mum.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Every day.
Every person.

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: To write beautifully.
I try very hard to write nicely.

examples.text: Вот теперь кусочки нарезаны красиво и аккуратно.
examples.trans: Now the pieces are cut beautifully and neatly.

examples.text: Сколько времени нужно отбивать каждый кусок?
examples.trans: How much time does each piece need tenderizing?

examples.text: Он же тебя просто на куски порежет!
examples.trans: After all, he will simply slice you into pieces!
Do you personally inspect every piece?
May I have another slice?
Eat a slice of cake.

examples.text: Можно ещё кусочек? И шампанское можно выпить?
examples.trans: May I have another slice? And can I drink the champagne?
Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.
Chop the onion for the salad.

examples.text: Попробуй! Лук, соль, перец — и всё.
examples.trans: Try it! Onion, salt, pepper — and that's all.

meanings.note: мелкими буквами = in small print / small letters

examples.trans: You don't read the small print.
There is only small change in my pocket.

examples.text: Женщина, вы мелкими буквами не читаете. Наша фирма в этом не виновата.
examples.trans: Ma'am, you don't read the small print. Our firm isn't to blame for that.

examples.text: Я уже приготовил специальный деревянный молоток.
examples.trans: I already prepared a special wooden mallet.

examples.text: Это слово «молоток» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'hammer' is often heard in conversation.

examples.text: Мясо должно стать мягким и сочным.
examples.trans: The meat must become tender and juicy.

examples.text: У тебя очень милые мягкие кудри.
examples.trans: You have very sweet, soft curls.
But here the metal is too soft.
Where do you get your meat?
Very tasty meat!

examples.text: И мой тоже готов! А ты где мясо берёшь?
examples.trans: And mine is ready too! Where do you get your meat?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: to cut into portions or pieces

examples.text: Вот теперь кусочки нарезаны красиво и аккуратно.
examples.trans: Now the pieces are cut beautifully and neatly.

examples.text: Сначала мелко нарежь лук и морковь.
examples.trans: First chop the onion and carrot finely.
I will cut the vegetables into even pieces.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I don't know.
There wasn't enough money.
Chef, I didn't take it.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.
You need to rest.

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: to pound meat with a mallet

examples.trans: Now tenderize the fresh meat properly.

examples.text: Сколько времени нужно отбивать каждый кусок?
examples.trans: How much time does each piece need tenderizing?

meanings.note: also political party or game of chess

examples.trans: The second batch is ready!
A new batch of shashlik.

examples.text: Вторая партия готова! Идём, сфотографируемся все вместе!
examples.trans: The second batch is ready! Come on, let's take a photo all together!
I'm here about the job.
We're talking on the phone.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.
This is a total nightmare!

examples.text: На столе стоял полный стакан воды.
examples.trans: A full glass of water stood on the table.

examples.text: Ну что я тебе скажу, Аркаша? Это полный кошмар!
examples.trans: Well, what can I tell you, Arkasha? This is a total nightmare!

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.
Everything is in complete order.

examples.text: Теперь давай всё по порядку. Скажи мне, сколько ты им должна?
examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order. Tell me, how much do you owe them?
That's right.
You said it right.

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.trans: I made a cake.
Mum cooked a delicious dinner.

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?
examples.trans: I made a cake. Do you have a sweet tooth?

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.trans: I work as mayor.
Where do you work?

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.
That means thousands of jobs.
A working day.

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.en: to cut, to slice, to carve
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cut, to slice', paired with 'разрезать'.

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!
She is slicing bread.

examples.text: Нина, ну как ты могла? Живого человека ножом резать!
examples.trans: Nina, how could you? Cutting a living person with a knife!

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.
Fresh berries on the table.
I bought fresh bread.

examples.text: Свежие ягоды, кофе! У вас тут романтический завтрак.
examples.trans: Fresh berries, coffee! You are having a romantic breakfast here.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: He keeps his word.
They are building their houses.

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?
So much gum!
How much is it?
So much gum! Cool!

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Are you watching us?
Keep an eye on the child.
What, are you watching us?

meanings.note: в следующий раз = next time; следующий! = next, please!

examples.trans: Don't be late next time.
Next, please!

examples.text: А ты в следующий раз на мои деньги не рассчитывай. И всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Well, next time don't count on my money. And everything will be fine.

examples.text: Мясо должно стать мягким и сочным.
examples.trans: The meat must become tender and juicy.

examples.text: Но сочные мясные котлеты такие вкусные!
examples.trans: But juicy meat cutlets are so tasty!

examples.text: Мясо получилось очень нежным и сочным.
examples.trans: The meat turned out very tender and juicy.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.trans: Thanks, Dad!
Thank you for your trust!

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: special, designed for a particular purpose

examples.trans: Calm down, the special operation continues.
A special tool is needed for this.
Everyone down! Special forces at work!

стараться.gloss: to try, to make an effort

meanings.en: to try hard, to make an effort
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тараться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to try, to make an effort', paired with 'постараться'.

examples.trans: Marina, you're trying in vain.
He always tries to help his friends.

examples.text: Марина, зря вы стараетесь. Он никогда не уйдёт от своей Аллы Евгеньевны.
examples.trans: Marina, you're trying in vain. He will never leave his Alla Evgenyevna.
He became mayor.
You've changed.

examples.text: Ты слишком сентиментальным стал. А лидер должен быть жёстким.
examples.trans: You've become too sentimental. And a leader has to be tough.
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: Не бойся, всё в порядке! Посидим дружно за столом.
examples.trans: Don't be afraid, everything is fine! We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.
Take your feet off the table quickly!
Now I'm the boss.
Now everything's fine.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!
That was a very subtle move.

examples.text: У нее тонкий вкус в искусстве.
examples.trans: She has delicate taste in art.
That was a very subtle move!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: Lyolya will definitely come!

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

examples.text: Точно, полиция была! А что с машиной?
examples.trans: That's right, the police were there! And what about the car?
I have a toy car.
He's at our place.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
examples.trans: Hi! Look what I've got.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
Dad is already home.
I'm already home.
Good!
Everything's fine.
Good! Everything's fine over there.

examples.text: У меня здесь всегда полная чистота.
examples.trans: I always have complete cleanliness here.
We must urgently establish perfect cleanliness.

examples.text: Да, шеф требует идеальной чистоты везде.
examples.trans: Yes, Chef demands perfect cleanliness everywhere.
Cleverly thought out, boss!
The boss signed the order.
The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: That's mine.
And this is for you.
And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I'm doing my homework.
I grew up here.
Chef, I didn't take it.
